messages:
Nina_CSM: HorizonBridge pilot in SG is scheduled for 2026-04-15 09:00 SGT. They asked for port-based allowlist on apac-edge + temporary soft QPS increase for 72h. Also called out renewal pricing as a blocker in the kickoff.
Laila (HorizonBridge): Confirmed. We'll originate from two host IPs: 198.51.100.10/32 and 198.51.100.11/32; they use TLS SNI 'hb-prod.svc'. Need ports 443 and 8443 allowed. Target soft_qps 140 (current ~45). Auto-revoke after 72h. Please keep logs for 14d and redact payload.
Omar_SE: We can support port+SNI rules and a soft QPS profile. I'll prepare a performance runbook and a cost delta for renewal. Also suggest enabling KV prefix caching to reduce cost if patterns fit.
Rui_NetOps: Staging ingress patch now. Planned manifest snippet: ```
allow_rule:
  tenant: HBR-34
  cidrs: ["198.51.100.10/32","198.51.100.11/32"]
  ports: [443,8443]
  sni: "hb-prod.svc"
qps:
  soft_limit: 140
  duration: 72h
  expire_at: 2026-04-18T09:00:00+08:00
logging:
  retention_days: 14
  redact_payloads: true
notes: "pilot - auto-revoke; renewal follow-up"
```
config-bot: Change staged by Rui_NetOps on apac-edge-1. Staging ID: stg-9d2f. Will apply at 2026-04-15T08:45:00+08:00.
Rui_NetOps: Applied patch stg-9d2f -> live. Port+SNI allowlist active; soft QPS set to 140. Alerts: 5xx > 0.4% or p95 token-latency > 320ms.
Laila (HorizonBridge): Initial smoke shows connections established; traffic rising toward ~80 qps. No 5xx. Thanks!
Nina_CSM: Capturing action items: Omar to produce perf+cost snapshot at T+24h; I'll schedule renewal touch 2 days after auto-revoke. Marking renewal-risk in CRM HBR-34.
Omar_SE: Will post perf snapshot (tokens, p95, cost/1k tokens, reservation delta) and a short optimization note. Planning 15-min checkpoint at T+24h.
Laila (HorizonBridge): One compliance request: can you provide a secure link to logs for 7 days to our security lead?
Rui_NetOps: Confirmed: 14d retention with payload redaction; creating scoped secure-view link valid for 7d for HBR-34.
Nina_CSM: Thanks team. If any anomalies, page oncall. I'll attach Omar's report to the CRM and propose a pilot discount in the renewal packet if costs look high.
config-bot: Audit: stg-9d2f -> live recorded by Rui_NetOps at 2026-04-15T08:47:00+08:00.
Rui_NetOps: Closing loop: auto-revoke scheduled; monitoring dashboards active. Will escalate if error rate crosses threshold.
Laila (HorizonBridge): Confirmed stable at 110 qps after 2h. Appreciate the fast turn-around.
